notes: Lineage from the page: Chrysler Airtemp (pre-1976), Fedders subsidiary from 1976, then the AirTemp name revived in 2012 by Nordyne (Nortek Global HVAC); the parent field reflects the reviving owner, the full chain is recorded here. Only page style 5 ships. Page styles 1-4 are held for the image pass (see report): style 1 (1960s-1970s single year digit, no text table), style 2 (1976-1977, year/month letters chart-only), style 3 (presumed 1950s-1974, single year digit, no text table), style 4 (Jan 1975-Dec 1984, two-letter month/year chart-only; only the single pair DS = February 1981 is stated in text, and a partial table must never ship as if complete). No usesStylesOf: the page states style 5 is a Nordyne/Nortek format, but only this one style is documented for AirTemp, so it is written out in full rather than inheriting all of Nordyne's styles.

styles.era: Current Nordyne/Nortek style, 2012 and after (page style 5)
styles.notes: Page example shown as 'VSG18 1150070' (space stripped by normalization). The page states year = 3rd & 4th positions and month = 5th & 6th positions; those only decode if read as 0-based indices [3,5] and [5,7] (giving 18 = 2018 and 11 = November), which also matches the Nordyne style-1 positions the page names as this format's source. The year/month values are therefore derived from the page example under those positions, not page-stated decodes. Style id keeps the page's style-5 numbering.
